prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, the scene captures a bustling airport gate where thick brushstrokes define the textures of worn luggage and polished floors. On the left, a woman in a blue coat stands firmly, holding a red passport tightly in her right hand while looking at a flight information screen mounted high on the wall. Next to her, a small boy in yellow overalls sits on a large black suitcase, his legs dangling freely as he watches a brown dog sniffing the floor nearby. The brown dog is tethered by a leather leash held by an elderly man in a grey hat who stands center-left, gently pulling the animal away from a spilled coffee cup. In the center, a businessman in a dark suit checks his silver wristwatch with an anxious expression, standing next to a towering stack of three beige boxes. A young girl in a pink dress points excitedly at a distant airplane visible through the glass window, her finger extended toward the tarmac. Beside her, a teenager in headphones leans against a metal pillar, ignoring the chaos around him while staring at a glowing tablet. To the right, a couple shares a tender moment; the man in a green jacket hands a tissue to the woman in a white scarf who wipes tears from her eyes. Behind them, a security officer in a navy uniform walks past, glancing briefly at a forgotten backpack resting on a bench. Near the boarding door, a pilot in a crisp white shirt adjusts his cap while speaking to a flight attendant in a purple uniform who holds a clipboard. A stray cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully under a row of empty chairs, curled into a tight ball. An old woman in a floral dress knits a blue sweater, her needles clicking softly as she waits. A child in a striped shirt runs toward the gate agent, who wears a bright yellow vest and gestures for calm. There is no digital clock displaying the time. There is no advertising billboard on the walls.
